verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers a no-key Cloud Console playground and $5 free credits to 'prototype prompts, agents, and real-time apps before you spend a dollar,' which lets a user experiment without hitting a paid/production billing tier, but there is no dedicated 'sandbox' API mode, test keys, or explicit separation from production data/environment documented. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test-mode endpoint or key type, documentation guaranteeing isolation from production data, and independent confirmation that free-tier usage never touches the same infra as production workloads.
